study_note: Seed-55 exploratory 14-million-decision Humanoid Walk screen of exact normalized squashed-action behavior cross-entropy with a terminal coefficient of 0.03 and a 500,000-eligible-update smoothstep ramp; one training seed does not support a confidence or significance claim. It differs from the matched reverse-KL arm only in the behavior objective, isolating removal of the KL current-policy entropy term. Both critic targets remain reward-only, and automatic outer temperature tuning uses the normalized rho-weighted actor-depth mixture. At step zero and every 50,000 decisions, the observational evaluation runs the 100-sample fixed-seed Q-versus-MC protocols and five seed-12345 paired real-environment episodes comparing deterministic outer control with deterministic execution after a fresh action-local inner SAC solve at every state. The primary improvement signal is eval/paired_fresh_inner_minus_outer; with inner_diagnostic_rollouts=0, the evaluator also records the fixed-target root-Q action-gain distribution without extra diagnostic model rollouts. Positive predicted Q gain with negative real return delta indicates critic/model optimism or compounded distribution shift. These probes add substantial evaluation-only compute that is timed separately; they do not alter training or consume its decision budget.
